activity.role: Military actor in Yi Ja-gyeom crisis
activity.notes: Cheok Jun-gyeong participated with Yi Ja-gyeom in the February 1126 armed court uprising that burned the palace and killed royal loyalists. Later, after persuasion by Choe Sa-jeon and the king's intervention, he turned against and captured Yi Ja-gyeom in May 1126. This entry preserves both his initial rebel involvement and subsequent switch to the royal side; neither is collapsed into the simplistic claim that he always defended royal legitimacy. It is distinct from his existing military service and Jurchen campaign Activity 1104–1119, and is an activity within the existing Goryeo polity, not a sovereign state founded by Cheok.
